lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Reward: High-Capacity Hard Drive ×2

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It's not much, but here's your reward.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I can't thank you enough T^T

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Although I'm quite well-versed in the fruits from the surface,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: these are all new to me!!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I have to take my time with them.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Did anything noteworthy happened?
I saw a cow.
Nothing special.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: A cow?!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text:
I've only seen pictures of then in textbooks...
Oh, how I envy you!! T^T

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: What did it look like?
It was quite large. Cute as well.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Wooooow, that's amazing!!!!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: So nothing special happened then?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Well, then I'm glad you made it back safe.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: It would have been nice if you'd encountered some wildlife :(

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: but I suppose that's next to impossible.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Anyway, thank you so much.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: One day, I will go up to the surface on my own

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: to see all flora and fauna for myself.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: All right, I'll be in touch!
